meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'елиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'shared', paired with 'делиться'.

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'медленно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.en: to remove, to take away, to cut out
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'брать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'take away / remove', paired with 'убирать'.
